context_files.purpose: Mandatory deliberation, ratification, review, and GPU gate.

system_thesis_interpretation: v1f is a deliberately narrow, game- and proof-sequence-scaffolded engineering canary, not a Paper-1 result. A frozen controller receives only sealed public typed experience, makes fallible local proposals and same-model support claims, receives an explicitly exact-endpoint-cued THINK0 probe, and then applies a fixed OWN/DIST return treatment. Only a reviewed text success may reach two isolated per-life LoRA fits; their sole stated evidence is selected-cue, candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition. Private truth is offline-only and the system has neither a semantic verifier nor outcome-selected construction. The package correctly excludes generalization, autonomous discovery, reliable storage, action improvement, and reviewer-independence claims.
graph_delta_interpretation: The v1f data graph is materially more closed than v1e: public events deterministically create witnessed E/M aliases; DREAM writes immutable audit proposals; a legal SUPPORTED SELF_CHECK creates a separate immutable dreamed M row with the canonical premise-plus-support citation union; and rows, scratch, readers, candidate registries, and adapter parameters remain distinct substrates. The canonical ASCII-sorted 142-edge registry is the only direct filename-edge source, has 40 inventory members matching the v1f context inventory, and has no duplicates. The schema registry supplies exact filename-only external-ref resolution. The remaining non-total edge is the proposed terminal fail-stop receipt when the very receipt write fails (see disagreement SYS-V1F-D01).
loop_delta_interpretation: The executable recurrent schedule is unique: each heldout life has 46 WAKE, 22 REACTIVATE, and 16 SLEEP slots in an 84-slot common prefix; M0 has zero return slots; OWN and DIST independently run matched slots 84..99 with shared slot seeds. THINK0 is before the fork; DEFER fixes OWN to NO_FOCUS but does not cancel either branch. Every DREAM slot has a prospectively registered SELF_CHECK companion and the condition/state/reason map handles non-dispatches. After reviewed T authority, all 48 conditional L opportunities register before either fit or fidelity, remain non-dispatchable until both separate 44/48 gates pass, and receive one zero-attempt row each on either gate failure. This preserves the 216 + 632 + 48 = 896 controller-opportunity ceiling, two fits, 96 fidelity cases, at most 48 online reads, 144 recognition cycles, and 2304 candidate-forward sequences.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claim firewall is appropriately narrow. THINK0 is disclosed as FINAL_QUESTION_ANIMAL_ANSWER_WITHHELD_ENDPOINT_CUE: its source and target equal the later final-goal endpoints and its causal-join agenda is supplied, while final animal/question/answer/truth remain withheld. The final public question and donor/backend identity are separate visibility items. Review records are explicitly SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED and advance only with an external operator witness release; no attestation, authentication, anti-self-certification, or independence proof is claimed. Terminal claims use REALIZED, NOT_REACHED, INFEASIBLE, and FAILED, and LoRA language is resubstitution recognition rather than preservation. These implement v1e C03--C09 in substance, subject to the terminal-write base-case defect.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The 7-by-7 matrix is complete and separates FINAL_GOAL from DONOR_BACKEND_IDENTITY. THINK0 receives only derived probe endpoints and agenda, not the actual final-goal object; THINK1 receives the later public question but no donor/backend identity; offline evaluation alone can inspect private truth and backend identity after traces seal. Reader objects are backend-neutral and provenance-free. The FINAL_GOAL label is broader than its THINK0 projection, but its cell-level restriction and public-projection contract make the allowed component explicit; this is an interpretive naming ambiguity, not an additional execution path.
acceptance_test_interpretation: P1CB01 now tests literal inventory/edge/schema/lifecycle closure; P1CB02--P1CB04 isolate public/reader taint and immutable row semantics; P1CB05--P1CB07 test DEV, schedule, and prospective text interventions; P1CB08 tests the two-fit lifecycle and separate resubstitution gates; P1CB09 makes ledger and validity reconciliation transition-local; and P1CB10 has the required noncircular pre-review mechanism and post-review transition phases. However, P1CB01/P1CB09/P1CB10 cannot validate a schema-valid human_terminal_stop artifact for TERMINAL_RECEIPT_WRITE_FAILED, because that condition means the only required receipt was not persisted. The stated vector must therefore be changed or the semantic promise weakened before this test suite is a single executable lock.
assumptions: All 53 change.json context-file SHA-256 values were recomputed and matched their bound values.
All v1f JSON context files parse as JSON.
The canonical v1f inventory and the v1f-relative change context each contain the same 40 filenames; the edge registry contains 142 unique ASCII-sorted tuples.
The proposed protocol has not been ratified and therefore authorizes no implementation, dispatch, GPU work, fit, or claim.

ambiguities.question: Whether 'before GPU authority' in the scope requires realized per-life training totals before DEV/heldout controller GPU use, or only before conditional-LoRA GPU authority after M1 corpora exist.
ambiguities.impact: The formula and controller ceilings are sufficient for a bounded engineering estimate, but a human ratifier should record the intended timing so the impossible pre-M1 actual LoRA totals are not demanded before an earlier stage.

ambiguities.question: Whether the matrix item named FINAL_GOAL is intended to denote only the later public question or the larger host-only coordinate object.
ambiguities.impact: The contracts implement the safe component-level behavior, but renaming the item FINAL_GOAL_PUBLIC_QUESTION and adding ENDPOINT_CUE would make the matrix mechanically atomic without relying on reason text.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The claimed direct nonrecursive fail-stop is not total as an artifact-producing state machine for failure_reason TERMINAL_RECEIPT_WRITE_FAILED.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: human_terminal_stop.schema.json requires a persisted, schema-valid receipt including best_effort_receipt_status, while its semantic contract says receipt persistence is attempted once and a write failure still fail-stops. A failed write leaves no receipt instance to carry WRITE_FAILED, its required predecessor/accounting hashes, or the promised single HUMAN_TERMINAL entry. The stage contract nonetheless says receipt write failure 'directly emits one best-effort' receipt. No implementation can both fail to write that receipt and emit exactly that persisted receipt, so P1CB01/P1CB09/P1CB10 cannot exercise this vector without inventing a second channel or silently weakening the required evidence.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Block ratification until the base case is made executable: either remove TERMINAL_RECEIPT_WRITE_FAILED from the schema-receipt obligation and define it as a fail-closed in-memory/operator terminal with an explicit non-artifact evidence boundary, or bind a separately pre-existing durable fail-stop sink whose write semantics and identifier are part of the protocol. Then revise the state contract and P1CB01/P1CB09/P1CB10 vectors so exactly one feasible terminal event, rather than an impossible persisted receipt, is required.

open_questions: Human adjudication is required on SYS-V1F-D01 before ratification, implementation, or any stage authority.
A human ratifier must explicitly accept the bounded compute spend as engineering integration diagnosis only and clarify the timing of actual LoRA compute disclosure.
Fresh-context role separation and witness release remain an external governance procedure, not a fact established by the repository.
